title: Specification verification
description: What checks the specification's own documents. Its semantics are not executable yet (OI-12).

entities.title: Complete JSON examples in the specification pass the schema
entities.summary: Every fenced json block in spec/*.md that parses and is a UTV value (schema starting utv/) must pass the structural schema.
criteria: Each complete embedded UTV example passes schema/utv-1.0.schema.json.
Illustrative fragments that do not parse, and utv-result illustrations, are skipped.

entities.title: Every falsehood in the matrix has a scenario
entities.summary: The ids in spec/FALSEHOODS-MATRIX.md and conformance/scenarios/falsehoods.json are the same set.
criteria: No matrix row without a scenario, and no falsehood scenario without a row.
